text:
Ava (People Ops): Hey all — kicking off our Spring Spot Awards + Micro-Grant nominations. Quick bullets: $500 per person, up to 30 awards, accept retroactive Q2 impact, manager checkbox on form. Nominate by EOD Wed (1762104723). Form: https://tiny.redwood/recog-spring (internal)
Sam (People Ops): Confirming amount and max recipients?
Ava (People Ops): Yep $500 each, total cap 30 this quarter. Leadership adds a personalized note to recipients.
Jules (Eng): If a contributor led a production save in early April, can we still nominate?
Ava (People Ops): Absolutely — retro to start of Q2 fine. Emphasis on short concrete impact stories.
Rajat (Sales): Do managers need to pre-approve before anyone submits?
Ava (People Ops): Prefer manager sign-off at submission time (single checkbox). If manager is OOO, a Slack approval screenshot is acceptable.
Maya (Design): Idea: surface quick peer shoutouts via emoji in #random, then funnel top names to the form. Low friction.
Sam (People Ops): Love that. Two-step flow: 1) reactions in #random for 3 days, 2) People Ops pulls top 10 and reaches out for full nomination details.
Ava (People Ops): We'll post pinned instructions in #company-recognition and #random. Need someone to write the pinned copy.
Sam (People Ops): I'll draft and post before COB.
Jules (Eng): Logistics Q: recipients at the offsite — do they get physical tokens?
Ava (People Ops): Yes — $500 grant (digital) plus on-site token (pin + certificate). If remote, we ship the token.
Rajat (Sales): For team-level "Customer Hero" nominations, is there a separate process?
Ava (People Ops): There's a team award option on the form and one team trophy budget per quarter. Check "team nomination" and "trophy requested."
Maya (Design): Can we add a short prompt (100 words) for "what they did and why it mattered" to help judges?
Ava (People Ops): Good call — will add 100-200 word prompt to the form.
Sam (People Ops): Timeline recap: nominations close Wed 17:00 PT (1762104723). People Ops + two exec judges will review by Friday, announce winners next Monday.
reward-bot: Nomination form live. Remaining micro-grants: 30. Link: https://tiny.redwood/recog-spring
Jules (Eng): Are nominations anonymized during judging?
Ava (People Ops): Judges see anonymized impact statements for scoring. People Ops reveals names after the scoring pass for finalization.
Rajat (Sales): I'll nudge Sales managers in the all-hands and put a calendar reminder.
Maya (Design): I'll record a 2-min Loom walking through the form for folks who ask.
Sam (People Ops): After awards, we'll create a Confluence gallery with photos and short blurbs to highlight recipients and their career impact.
Ava (People Ops): I'll own the gallery. Thanks team! :sparkles: (Sam reacted :thumbsup:)
